title: 春が来た (Haru ga Kita — Spring Has Come)
description: A jubilant 1910 Meiji-era school song celebrating spring's arrival. Three short verses ask the same question — 'Spring has come, where has it come?' — and answer with mountains, villages, and fields. Then flowers bloom and birds sing in the same places. The simple, repetitive structure and cheerful vocabulary make it one of Japan's most recognizable songs for young learners.
